description: Venue catalog for the Publications charts. Categories are listed in priority order (keyword fallback ties go to the earlier category). Venues are matched by case-sensitive acronyms or by official names/aliases. Within a category, the top venue is the highest prestige score; ties prefer formal rankings over internal assessments, then the earlier venue in this list.

prestige_scale.description: Internal normalized comparison scale used only to compare venues on this site. Each formal ranking system is mapped with its own table below; the cross-system mapping is a site convention, not an equivalence asserted by CORE or SCImago.

CORE2023.label: CORE 2023
CORE2023.description: CORE Conference Ranking, 2023 edition (latest available). Only the ranks A*, A, B and C are scored; Australasian, National, Unranked and TBR entries are treated as unranked.

SJR2025.label: SJR 2025
SJR2025.description: SCImago Journal Rank 2025, best quartile across the journal's subject categories.

internal_assessment.label: Internal assessment
internal_assessment.description: Subjective score (1–4) assigned by the site owner only to venues that no formal system ranks. Each assessment must include a rationale and is always labelled as internal on the site.
